title: Staged launch lanes and fallback grid — Jul 2026 (WIP)
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact, action-oriented weekly ops slate for a staged production launch. It focuses on: 1) explicit "lanes" (parallel canaries and customer cohorts), 2) a compact fallback grid that maps failure modes to mitigations, and 3) an annotated timeline for day-of execution and post-release follow-up. This is a working draft intended for the release conductor and on-call owners.

Scope and constraints:
- Release: runtime v2.9.1 + batching/kv-cache config changes.
- Target regions: us-west1 (primary), eu-west1 (staged), ap-northeast1 (hold).
- Risk surface: kernel selection changes + quantization profile tweak may increase p95 and error surface for long-context requests (>4096 tokens).

Pre-window checklist (48–0h):
- Code freeze: tag release branch and lock merges (owner: Arjun).
- Smoke PRs: merge PR #334 and run smoke-suite in staging with sample 4k-token prompts (owner: Maya).
- Migration dry-run: run migration script on staging DB replica, verify idempotence (owner: Sofia).
- Canary keys & secrets: validate KMS rotation status for private tenants (owner: SRE ops).
- Telemetry: ensure dashboards for "LLM-serving / Errors", "Token-cost per request", "KV-hit ratio" are pinned and alerting is enabled.
- Communication: post preflight note to #release-ops with exact T0 and contingency numbers.

Staged lanes (definitions):
- Lane A: Internal traffic (5% of overall traffic) — purpose: fast feedback loop, full tracing.
- Lane B: Beta customers + top customers (10%) — purpose: verify business-critical flows and SLA-sensitive paths.
- Lane C: Public sample (25% progressive) — purpose: verify stability at scale.
- Lane D: Full ramp (60%) — only used after all gates pass at C.

Day-of timeline (T0 = announced start):
- T0 -30m: Final on-call rotation check, confirm wallclock times and handoffs.
- T0: Enable Lane A (internal 5%). Baseline metrics capture (30m window).
- T0 +30m: Evaluate lane A telemetry. Gate: errors <= 0.25% and p95 latency <= baseline*1.4. If fail -> evict to fallback-grid action FG-01.
- T0 +60m: Enable Lane B (add 10%) and keep A. Monitor for 45m. Gate: no regression in 4xx/5xx spike >2x and no KV-hit drop >8%.
- T0 +120m: Start progressive ramp for Lane C: 5% -> 12% -> 25% over 90m increments. At each step, check TPS, p99, and cost-per-token drift.
- T0 +6h: If all previous gates pass, plan a decision meeting for Lane D ramp. Execute only with release conductor sign-off.

Telemetry gates (explicit thresholds):
- Error rate (5xx): immediate rollback if >0.5% sustained for 5m.
- Client-visible errors (4xx): investigate; pause ramp if >1% sustained for 10m.
- p95 latency: pause if >1.8x baseline for 15m.
- KV-cache hit ratio: if drops >12% relative to baseline, throttle batching or revert quantization profile.
- Cost: abort ramp if cost-per-1000-tokens increases >40% unexpectedly without quality docs.

Fallback grid (failure mode -> graded mitigation):
- FG-01: Latency spike in kernel path -> Action: switch to conservative kernel set (automated route), reduce batch size by 25%, and notify infra-team.
- FG-02: Elevated token generation errors for long-context -> Action: enable short-context fallback model (lower memory variant) for lanes B/C, reduce max_context to 2048 for new sessions.
- FG-03: Sudden GPU OOM or worker death -> Action: migrate affected traffic to us-east warm pool and enable degraded-availability mode (limit concurrency).
- FG-04: KV cache corruption or cache-miss storm -> Action: flush cache namespace, disable prefix caching for 10m, revert recent cache config.
- FG-05: Cost runaway -> Action: engage finance > pause non-critical lanes (C/D), switch to capped per-route token limits.

Escalation matrix and owners:
- Release conductor: Maya Chen (final go/no-go).
- SRE primary: Liam O'Connell (service health and infra fallbacks).
- Runtime lead: Arjun Patel (kernel/quantization rollbacks).
- Product/CS liaison: Sofia Rivera (customer comms and beta customer gating).
- Exec notify: Heather Park (if Sev2 within first 6h).

Communications plan (who, when, how):
- Preflight (T0 -30m): Slack post in #release-ops with short checklist, link to this doc.
- On anomaly: rapid update to #release-ops and @pagerduty-runbook group; prepare one-line status for customer-success.
- After ramp to Lane C and stable: short release note in #product-releases and ping customer success channel with list of affected customers.

Release notes (draft):
- Headline: runtime v2.9.1 — improved batching + better kernel selection for long-context workloads.
- What changed: updated kernel scheduler for Llama-family blocks; default quantization tuned to reduce memory footprint by ~22% for 8k-ish runs; new KV-cache eviction smoothing.
- Customer impact: expected lower tail latency for short requests; long-context requests may see slightly different tokenization behavior (see known issues).
- Rollback instructions: revert runtime tag v2.9.1 -> v2.9.0; revert quant profile via feature-flag qprofile:stable.
- Known issues: occasional higher p95 on mixed-token-size heavy prompt sequences. Workaround: set max_context=2048 for affected sessions.

Post-release checklist (0–72h):
- 0–6h: Continuous monitoring, ensure errors < threshold and cost within forecast.
- 6–24h: Collect customer feedback, keep Beta cohort engaged; open follow-up tickets for quality regressions.
- 24–72h: Run synthetic long-context test sweep; evaluate p99 trends and update kernel mapping if required.
- 72h: Postmortem template: fill incident summary, gates observed, action items, owner assignment.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Is ap-northeast1 held intentionally for a separate canary or should it receive a delayed Lane C at 48h? (Need product sign-off.)
- Approve transient reduction of batch size (25%) as a standard fallback.

Appendix: quick commands and dashboards
- Rollback (one-liner): ./scripts/deploy.sh --tag v2.9.0 --force-route-all
- Dashboards: /dashboards/LLM-serving/overview, /dashboards/LLM-serving/kv-health, /dashboards/Cost/Per-token
- Pagerduty runbook: PD-llm-ops (link in linked_artifacts).

Notes to self (short):
- Keep this doc compact. Replace with canonical runbook after this week if lanes and FG mapping are validated.
- Add a compact table mapping lane -> sample customer list for easier rollbacks per customer in next revision.
